main.description: An image in Jeff's media library, uploaded in the admin app's Media section. The record keeps the file: a PDS removes a blob no record uses. The site serves it at /media/<cid>, so a post can use it as ![alt](/media/<cid>).

name.description: What it's called in the library, e.g. its file name.

alt.description: What the image shows, for people who can't see it: used when it's copied as Markdown.
